text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty incident INC-202603 triggered for service hosted-inference-prod
incidentbot: Trigger: 5xx-rate > 1.5% for last 5m / latency p95 > 800ms
PagerDuty: Escalation policy 'night-watch' fired. Notifying primary on-call via SMS + call.
Ethan: got it, oncall. Acking now...
Ethan: ack failed — PagerDuty reports SMS delivery failed (bounce). trying call.
Ethan: call to primary rang, no answer.
incidentbot: Primary unacknowledged -> escalating to secondary
PagerDuty: Secondary page attempt: SMS returned 429 (SMS_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT). Call attempt failed after 2 rings.
Priya: I'm secondary. SMS didn't go through, I'm on wifi only. pinged on slack, can you DM call me?
Jordan: I'm nearby, can help with quick mitigation while Priya gets voice. What are current impact metrics?
Carla: Grafana: hosted-inference-prod 5xx spikes 1.9% over baseline, affected request rate concentrated in eu-west region. p95 latency 920ms. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/hosted-inference-prod/overview
Marta: Paging manager via phone (manager on-call) — manager ring succeeded, left VM; connecting now.
Jordan: Immediate mitigation proposal: change routing policy to prefer dedicated pool in us-west-2 for EU latency-sensitive customers and enable prefix cache for common requests. This is low-risk rollback.
Ethan: agree. executing runbook step: reroute to dedicated pool (dry-run then switch)
Ethan: ```
# runbook excerpt
/runbook reroute-service --service hosted-inference-prod --from auto-pool --to dedicated-pool-us-west-2 --scope eu-west
# confirm: monitor 5xx and p95 for 2 minutes
```
Ethan: dry-run passed, applying now.
incidentbot: Change executed: traffic shift started (10% -> 60% over 90s) — monitor.
Carla: after 60s 5xx down to 0.8%, p95 down to 620ms. still monitoring.
Priya: I got voice page and acked. joining bridge.
Marta: Manager on bridge. we've identified SMS gateway throttle as root cause for missed ack path. PagerDuty attempted primary via sms twice then call.
Jordan: action items: 1) keep traffic routed to dedicated pool until SMS gateway issue confirmed resolved 2) open support ticket with SMS vendor 3) update status page with "degraded performance, mitigation in place"
Priya: taking ownership of vendor ticket. setting urgency P1.
incidentbot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, severity=sev2, owner=Priya, bridge=https://meet.internal/incident/INC-202603
Alex: I'm next on rotation, will take the handoff in 10m. Priya, will you coordinate the handoff?
Priya: yes, handing off after stabilization — I'll do a quick checklist and post runbook steps.
Carla: customer impact note for PMs: a subset (~3% of requests, mostly EU customers) saw latency and 5xx; no data loss; mitigation applied. tagging support to prepare comms.
Jordan: ETA to close: depends on SMS vendor response; can revert to normal routing once gateway backlog clears. Recommend follow-up postmortem and PD escalation policy review (fallback to voice earlier if SMS fails).
Ethan: adding postmortem owner tag: @Priya
Priya: thanks. creating incident ticket and assigning follow-ups.
incidentbot: auto-close timer suppressed (incident marked active). Please update when resolved. :shipit:
